description.text:
The ninth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 14 January 2022, which introduced Pokémon VSTAR. Arceus VSTAR leads it: its VSTAR Power, the Ability Starbirth, takes any two cards from the deck, and its attack Trinity Nova does 200 damage and attaches up to three basic Energy from the deck to its player's Pokémon V. Charizard VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power attack Star Blaze does 320 damage, Shaymin VSTAR and Whimsicott VSTAR join it, with Lumineon V, whose Ability takes a Supporter from the deck as it comes into play, Double Turbo Energy, the Stadium Magma Basin and the Supporters Cynthia's Ambition, Cheren's Care and Kindler; its Professor's Research shows Professor Rowan. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Arceus VSTAR, Ultra Ball and Magma Basin. In English most of its cards came out in Brilliant Stars in February 2022.

Pokémon VSTAR evolve from Pokémon V, like Pokémon VMAX, but give up two Prize cards when knocked out instead of three. Each has a VSTAR Power, an Ability or an attack strong enough to turn a battle, which a player may use only once a game. In Star Birth and the Battle Region pack that followed, every Pokémon that evolves from a Pokémon V is a Pokémon VSTAR.
